arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَبٰرَكَ الَّذى بِيَدِهِ المُلكُ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
transliteration: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
translation: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things

arabic: الَّذى خَلَقَ المَوتَ وَالحَيوٰةَ لِيَبلُوَكُم أَيُّكُم أَحسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الغَفورُ
transliteration: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru
translation: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving

arabic: الَّذى خَلَقَ سَبعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِباقًا ما تَرىٰ فى خَلقِ الرَّحمٰنِ مِن تَفٰوُتٍ فَارجِعِ البَصَرَ هَل تَرىٰ مِن فُطورٍ
transliteration: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin
translation: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts

arabic: ثُمَّ ارجِعِ البَصَرَ كَرَّتَينِ يَنقَلِب إِلَيكَ البَصَرُ خاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسيرٌ
transliteration: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun
translation: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim

arabic: وَلَقَد زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنيا بِمَصٰبيحَ وَجَعَلنٰها رُجومًا لِلشَّيٰطينِ وَأَعتَدنا لَهُم عَذابَ السَّعيرِ
transliteration: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri
translation: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame

arabic: وَلِلَّذينَ كَفَروا بِرَبِّهِم عَذابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
transliteration: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru
translation: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end

arabic: إِذا أُلقوا فيها سَمِعوا لَها شَهيقًا وَهِىَ تَفورُ
transliteration: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru
translation: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up

arabic: تَكادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الغَيظِ كُلَّما أُلقِىَ فيها فَوجٌ سَأَلَهُم خَزَنَتُها أَلَم يَأتِكُم نَذيرٌ
transliteration: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun
translation: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner

arabic: قالوا بَلىٰ قَد جاءَنا نَذيرٌ فَكَذَّبنا وَقُلنا ما نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيءٍ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا فى ضَلٰلٍ كَبيرٍ
transliteration: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin
translation: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error

arabic: وَقالوا لَو كُنّا نَسمَعُ أَو نَعقِلُ ما كُنّا فى أَصحٰبِ السَّعيرِ
transliteration: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri
translation: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames

arabic: فَاعتَرَفوا بِذَنبِهِم فَسُحقًا لِأَصحٰبِ السَّعيرِ
transliteration: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri
translation: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم بِالغَيبِ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَأَجرٌ كَبيرٌ
transliteration: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun
translation: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

arabic: وَأَسِرّوا قَولَكُم أَوِ اجهَروا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
transliteration: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
translation: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men)

arabic: أَلا يَعلَمُ مَن خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطيفُ الخَبيرُ
transliteration: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru
translation: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware

arabic: هُوَ الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ ذَلولًا فَامشوا فى مَناكِبِها وَكُلوا مِن رِزقِهِ وَإِلَيهِ النُّشورُ
transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru
translation: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead)

arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَن فِى السَّماءِ أَن يَخسِفَ بِكُمُ الأَرضَ فَإِذا هِىَ تَمورُ
transliteration: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru
translation: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed

arabic: أَم أَمِنتُم مَن فِى السَّماءِ أَن يُرسِلَ عَلَيكُم حاصِبًا فَسَتَعلَمونَ كَيفَ نَذيرِ
transliteration: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri
translation: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning

arabic: وَلَقَد كَذَّبَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَكَيفَ كانَ نَكيرِ
transliteration: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri
translation: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)

arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا إِلَى الطَّيرِ فَوقَهُم صٰفّٰتٍ وَيَقبِضنَ ما يُمسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحمٰنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ بَصيرٌ
transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun
translation: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things

arabic: أَمَّن هٰذَا الَّذى هُوَ جُندٌ لَكُم يَنصُرُكُم مِن دونِ الرَّحمٰنِ إِنِ الكٰفِرونَ إِلّا فى غُرورٍ
transliteration: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin
translation: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion

arabic: أَمَّن هٰذَا الَّذى يَرزُقُكُم إِن أَمسَكَ رِزقَهُ بَل لَجّوا فى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفورٍ
transliteration: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin
translation: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness

arabic: أَفَمَن يَمشى مُكِبًّا عَلىٰ وَجهِهِ أَهدىٰ أَمَّن يَمشى سَوِيًّا عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
transliteration: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin
translation: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road

arabic: قُل هُوَ الَّذى أَنشَأَكُم وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمعَ وَالأَبصٰرَ وَالأَفـِٔدَةَ قَليلًا ما تَشكُرونَ
transliteration: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

arabic: قُل هُوَ الَّذى ذَرَأَكُم فِى الأَرضِ وَإِلَيهِ تُحشَرونَ
transliteration: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
translation: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered

arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
translation: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

arabic: قُل إِنَّمَا العِلمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّما أَنا۠ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun
translation: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner

arabic: فَلَمّا رَأَوهُ زُلفَةً سيـَٔت وُجوهُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَقيلَ هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعونَ
transliteration: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona
translation: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call

arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم إِن أَهلَكَنِىَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَعِىَ أَو رَحِمَنا فَمَن يُجيرُ الكٰفِرينَ مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ
transliteration: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin
translation: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom

arabic: قُل هُوَ الرَّحمٰنُ ءامَنّا بِهِ وَعَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلنا فَسَتَعلَمونَ مَن هُوَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin
translation: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest

arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم إِن أَصبَحَ ماؤُكُم غَورًا فَمَن يَأتيكُم بِماءٍ مَعينٍ
transliteration: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin
translation: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water
